Where the Two Sides Shook Hands

Grade 12 · HS English 11–12 · Design-Build Challenge

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The poster

As you record, the four sentences fill in. Put them in order so each one builds on the one before.

THE SCENE

Today your class has a bridge challenge. Two teams build one bridge, one team from each side. Your bridge is done, and the two sides met in the middle. Now you must write the poster for your bridge. The poster needs four sentences. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This challenge comes from a real tunnel under the sea. In 1988, England and France started digging toward each other. In 1990, the two sides met in the middle. Two workers, one from each country, shook hands.
